title: A Generic Plug and Play Navigation Fusion Strategy for Land Vehicles in GNSS Denied Environment
authors: Lai J.; Bai S.; Xu X.; Lü P.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
